input:
I’m trying to pull a full claim summary for a policyholder and need to print it out for our internal file — can you help me find where that’s configured?
The user cannot locate the configuration setting to print a full claim summary for internal filing.

I’m having trouble assigning roles to new team members on our claims dashboard.
The user is unable to assign roles to new team members within the claims dashboard.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders.
The customer is unable to access the policyholder documents section due to a password issue.

Right now, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later.
The platform does not allow users to verify third-party bank details before issuing payments, leading to failed transactions and reissuance delays.

each user needs dozens of boxes ticked manually and if we miss one, they get locked out. The permission setup duplication is really slowing us down.
The manual permission configuration process is inefficient and error-prone, requiring users to tick many individual boxes for each new team member.

we’ve had issues with supplier letters not triggering automatically, and it’s causing delays in task assignments.
Supplier letters are failing to trigger automatically, which delays task assignments.

One thing we’ve struggled with is payment detail checking — it’s causing delays.
The payment detail checking feature is difficult to use and causes processing delays.

The issue is we can’t copy access roles — each new user needs permissions manually assigned, and one mistake blocks them entirely.
Users cannot copy access roles, requiring manual permission assignment for each new user which is error-prone.

we’ve had issues with permissions before. Can you show how roles are assigned during setup?
The customer has previously experienced issues with permission settings and needs clarity on how to assign roles during the initial setup.

I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently.
The user is unable to access the claims portal due to a lockout and requires an urgent password reset.

when there are joint policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes only showing one or the wrong one, and it’s causing real issues with policyholders.
The system incorrectly merges or displays joint policyholder names, often showing only one name or the wrong one.

it’s taking forever to assign permissions. Each person needs a custom setup and I keep worrying I’ll miss something.
Assigning custom permissions to new team members is slow and error-prone.

we need payee account verification to prevent delays. It’s impacting our reserves and supplier reporting too.
The platform lacks a payee account verification feature, causing payment delays that negatively impact financial reserves and supplier reporting.

we’ve got a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays.
The third-party payee account verification process is causing recurring delays.

we need to copy access roles, not rebuild them from scratch every time.
The platform lacks a feature to duplicate existing access roles, forcing users to manually rebuild permissions for each new user.

can we adjust the roles so our junior staff can’t initiate payments without approval? We’ve had a couple of close calls.
The current role permissions allow junior staff to initiate payments without requiring an approval step, creating a risk of unauthorized transactions.

you can’t copy access roles — every new team member means manually selecting permissions one by one, and if you make a mistake, the handler gets locked out until it’s corrected.
The platform lacks a feature to copy access roles, forcing manual permission selection for each new team member and causing handlers to be locked out if errors occur.

I’ve pulled the supplier payments but the reserves still don’t align with what’s recorded.
The reserves recorded in the system do not match the supplier payment data.

we’ve been having some trouble with joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.
The system is incorrectly handling or displaying joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.

the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names
The system fails to display both names for joint policyholders, showing only one instead.

We’re struggling because we can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments — it forces us to reissue failed payments days later, which delays claims resolution for policyholders.
The platform lacks a feature to verify third-party payee bank details before payment, causing failed payments and delays in claims resolution.

I’m trying to filter tasks by due date because we’ve got multiple claims coming up and I need to prioritize them before the next reporting cycle.
The user is struggling to effectively filter tasks by due date to prioritize multiple upcoming claims.

when we send payments to third parties, the bank info isn’t verified ahead of time... payment detail checking isn’t happening before funds go out, so we’re stuck reissuing failed payments days later
The platform does not verify bank details for third-party payments before sending them, leading to failed transactions and delays.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because the 'Save' action in Reports does not work as expected.

Great. And how do you handle document versioning? We’ve lost track of updates before.
The customer is concerned about losing track of document updates and wants to know how the platform handles versioning.

we’ve hit a snag with supplier payments again.
The customer is experiencing issues with processing supplier payments.

the letters tab is greyed out too, and I can’t assign new tasks to my team since the roles aren’t syncing properly.
The letters tab is disabled and task assignment fails due to role synchronization issues.

I’m having trouble pulling up the latest reserves report for our marine cargo claims.
The customer is unable to access the latest reserves report for marine cargo claims.

can we adjust roles so only senior handlers see the integrations tab? It’s causing confusion.
The integrations tab is visible to all users, causing confusion for junior staff who do not need access.

the permission setup duplication is slowing us down
The process for duplicating permission setups is too slow when onboarding new claims teams.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard anymore.
The user is unable to access the claims dashboard due to a password issue.

We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
Letters sent to joint policyholders incorrectly display only one name instead of both.

can we discuss how policyholders receive automated letters? Some aren’t getting them.
Some policyholders are not receiving automated letters as expected.

We’ve had too many delays from payment detail checking.
The process of checking payment details is causing significant delays.

we need to update the purchase order reference on our most recent invoice — it’s causing reconciliation issues with our finance team.
The customer needs to update the purchase order reference on an invoice to fix reconciliation issues.

We’ve been waiting for that feature to reduce manual work on reserves and supplier reconciliations.
The customer currently performs manual work for reserves and supplier reconciliations because the desired automation feature is not yet available.

Claims: click "Open"
Claims: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because the save action in the claims interface is failing or behaving unexpectedly.

the system’s throwing an error when I filter by supplier payments.
The system throws an error when filtering the reserves report by supplier payments.

We’ve got a few joint policyholder cases where the letters are coming out with mismatched names—causing complaints.
The system generates letters with mismatched names for joint policyholder cases, leading to customer complaints.

the permission setup is taking ages — each user needs dozens of boxes ticked manually and if we miss one, they get locked out.
The manual permission setup process is time-consuming and error-prone, requiring users to tick many individual boxes which leads to access issues if missed.

The issue with letters merging multiple names on letters is causing us real problems — clients are complaining because only one name shows up, and sometimes it’s not even the right one.
The letter generation feature incorrectly merges multiple names, displaying only one name or the wrong name, which damages client trust.

I’m trying to reconcile the latest supplier payment against our claims reserves and I’m not sure if I’m updating the figures correctly.
The user is unsure how to correctly update figures when reconciling supplier payments against claims reserves.

letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing real friction with clients.
The system fails to display all names on letters sent to joint policyholders, showing only one name instead.

we’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time. It’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders.
The platform lacks a feature to verify third-party bank details before processing claims, leading to payment delays and reissues.

noticed quite a few that haven’t moved in months—could we get those bulk-closed to clean up the dashboard?
The user cannot bulk-close stale tasks to clean up the dashboard, which impacts reporting and reserves tracking.

when letters go out for policies with two named holders, the system only includes one name — and sometimes it’s the wrong one... led to some frustrated calls from policyholders and extra work for our team to fix the letters manually.
The system incorrectly populates only one name, often the wrong one, on letters for policies with two named holders.

Reports: click "Save", rage x3
The user is frustrated because the 'Save' action in Reports does not work as expected.

are tasks auto-assigned when letters go out to policyholders? We’re seeing delays.
Tasks are not being automatically assigned when letters are sent to policyholders, causing delays.

every time we issue payments to third-party suppliers, we can’t validate their bank details ahead of time, which means payments bounce and we’re stuck reissuing days later.
The platform lacks a feature to validate third-party supplier bank details before issuing payments, causing failed transactions and delays.

our letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing confusion and we need this fixed.
Letters sent to joint policyholders currently display only one name, causing confusion for recipients.

I’m already dreading the permissions setup — it’s so easy to miss a box and then someone gets locked out.
The permissions setup process is error-prone and difficult, leading to users being accidentally locked out.

Just need to know when we can expect the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in correspondence.
Joint policyholder names are not appearing correctly in generated correspondence.

It’s frustrating because bounced payments mean we’re reissuing them days later, which messes up our reserves and reporting.
Bounced payments require manual reissuance which delays the process and negatively impacts financial reserves and reporting accuracy.

I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?
The user is unable to import the latest supplier reports into the system.

we’ve got a repeat issue where letters sent to joint policyholders are only showing one name — it’s causing confusion and complaints from customers.
Letters sent to joint policyholders are incorrectly displaying only one name, leading to customer confusion and complaints.

I’m trying to reconcile the reserves for two recent claims at Elderfold Home, but the figures aren’t matching up with our internal spreadsheets.
The reserve figures in the platform do not match the customer's internal spreadsheet data, causing reconciliation issues.

payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays
The system releases funds before verifying payee account details, leading to re-issuance delays.

I need to reset my password because I’m locked out of the claims dashboard and can’t access policyholder documents.
The user is locked out of the claims dashboard and cannot access policyholder documents, requiring a password reset.

we’ve had two handlers locked out already this week just from missing a checkbox.
Users are being locked out of the system due to a confusing or easily missed checkbox requirement.

I’m trying to get a batch of claims documents uploaded and linked to the right reserves, but I’m not sure where the task queue sits in the interface.
The user cannot locate the task queue in the interface to manage claim document uploads and linking.

can we generate letters automatically based on claim status? We’re drowning in manual correspondence.
The platform lacks an automated feature to generate correspondence letters based on claim status, forcing users to handle this manually.

I can’t just copy the permissions from our existing role, so I’m having to click through every box for each person. It’s exhausting and I’m terrified I’ll lock someone out by accident.
The platform lacks a feature to duplicate or copy existing permission roles, forcing users to manually configure each setting for new team members.

We need to adjust the purchase order reference on the invoice you sent — it’s causing reconciliation problems with our finance team, and we’re hoping you can help with the purchase order correction.
The invoice generation process does not allow for easy correction of purchase order references, leading to reconciliation issues.

We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders. We really need payee account verification built into the workflow.
The platform lacks a feature to verify third-party bank details before payment, leading to delays and reissues.
